Name: Coal from Tree Seeds
Author: oxyk
Description:
Make coal from tree seeds (acorns, maple seed, pine cone) with sap as fuel

Requires ProducerFrameworkMod

Add 50 seeds of one type + 10 sap to receive 3-10 coal. Uses Charcoal Kiln.

My other Mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12849]Mixed Seeds from Forage[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12825]Updated Food Recipes[/url]

Downloads.Description: Version that works with Stardew Valley 1.6 and latest SMAPI
